title: Pulse techniques and apparatus, Part 2: Pulse measurement and analysis, general considerations
clause_1_scope: This standard provides definitions and descriptions of the techniques and procedures for time domain pulse measurements. The definitions and descriptions provided are independent of specific devices, apparatus, instruments or computing devices which may be used in pulse measurements and are necessary for: — efficient communication of the results of pulse measurement, — standards for pulse apparatus, and — standards for apparatus which employ pulse techniques.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
